item.title: 20-year-old killed in shooting in Birmingham
item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (WIAT) — A 20-year-old man died after being shot in Birmingham over the weekend. Eric Lemar Clayon, Jr., was shot in the 400 block of Lawson Road at 7:32 p.m. Friday. He was subsequently taken to UAB Hospital, where he died at 5:16 p.m. Saturday. item.title: Water restored to city of Pleasant Grove following day-long leak from split pipe
item.description: Water is slowly being restored to the city of Pleasant Grove after water main was split Tuesday, causing schools, businesses and even City Hall to close because of the lack of water.

item.title: Sarah Marsh Heaven's 27 Camp Safety Act passes Alabama House

item.title: Bessemer Planning and Zoning Commission approves recommendation to expand proposed data center site
item.description: The Bessemer Planning and Zoning Commission approved a recommendation to rezone 914 acres from agricultural to light industrial and the comprehensive preliminary development plan in a 6-1 vote Tuesday night.
